title: Chapter 305 - 305 Anger; Return!
content:
Chapter 305 - 305 Anger; Return!

Chapter 305 - 305 Anger; Return!

305 Anger; Return!

Huang Jiayi’s face darkened. He looked at Liu Jianqiang and Liu Sheng coldly.

He did not know what had happened.

However, Liu Sheng actually dared to insult Lin Fan. That was unforgivable.

Liu Jianqiang noticed the change in Huang Jiayi’s expression, and his heart skipped a beat.

When he saw how respectful Huang Jiayi was to Lin Fan, Liu Jianqiang was already thinking about how to please Lin Fan.

Now… what should he do?

At this moment, Liu Jianqiang did not care if Liu Sheng had been beaten up.

He hesitated and said, “Mr. Lin, there must be a misunderstanding between you and my son. He didn’t mean to scold you…”

Lin Fan glanced at Liu Jianqiang and said, “Misunderstanding? Did I misunderstand him for wanting to steal my girlfriend and threatening me?”

Stealing Lin Fan’s girlfriend and threatening him?

What a… bastard!

Huang Jiayi glanced at Liu Jianqiang and Liu Sheng coldly before grunting.

Liu Jianqiang’s body trembled slightly as he said, “C-Chairman Huang, this matter…”

Huang Jiayi did not wait for him to finish and interrupted him, “You don’t have to say anything anymore! From now on, our Tiantian Bank will not lend a single cent to your company!

“In addition, the previous loans must be repaid immediately!”

When Liu Jianqiang heard this, it was as if his strength had been instantly sucked dry, and his face was pale.

One had to know…

His Fenglin Real Estate was short of money.

Today, the main reason why he was traveling with the entrepreneurs was to get closer to the chairman of Tiantian Bank, Huang Jiayi.

This would make it easier to get some loans from the bank.

Now?

Now, not only could he not get a loan, but he also had to repay the previous loans immediately.

Liu Jianqiang felt the world spin.

Liu Sheng obviously had not expected this. He said again, “Our Liu family is not to be trifled with!”

When Liu Jianqiang heard this, he was like a tiger that had been slapped on the butt.

He… He was completely furious.

It was him. It was all this brat’s fault!

Otherwise, none of this would have happened!

Hence, Liu Jianqiang pointed to the front and shouted, “Captain, help me get close!”

Then, Liu Jianqiang jumped in front of Liu Sheng and raised his hand to slap his face.

“Bastard!

“Who told you to cause trouble for me?

“Bastard!”

As he hit, he cursed. He was furious to the extreme.

Regarding what was happening…

Lin Fan only took a few casual glances before continuing to admire the beautiful scenery in the distance with Qin Yuxuan.

Everyone in Fan Yu Investment was extremely happy and satisfied with this team-building event.

At the same time, the employees became more familiar with each other and understood each other better.

As for Lin Fan, he did not stay in Modu any longer.

After all, he was still a student.

After sending Lin Fan to the airport, Qin Yuxuan returned to the Global Financial Tower.

Senior Lu sighed. “Yuxuan, your boyfriend is really amazing. He actually owns the entire Global Financial Tower. Moreover, he’s the major shareholder of Tiantian Bank. He also has such a luxurious yacht!”

When Senior Lu said this, her eyes sparkled.

“By the way, did he take you shopping yesterday?” Senior Lu asked after a pause. “Did he give you anything?”

“He bought me a watch.”

As she spoke, Qin Yuxuan raised her wrist.

“He only bought a watch for you? Heavens! This is very pretty! How much was it?” Senior Lu bombarded her with questions.

As a woman, she could not resist such a beautiful watch.

“This is a Patek Phillipe watch. It costs 31 million yuan,” Qin Yuxuan said.

“31 million!” Senior Lu shouted out loud.

Initially, she wanted Qin Yuxuan to take off her watch for her to take a look.

At this moment, she completely dispelled this thought.

A watch worth 31 million yuan, what if… If she accidentally knocked it to the ground, what should she do?

“Also, he gave me a unit in Tomson Building No. 1 to live in,” Qin Yuxuan added.”

“Tomson Building No. 1!” Senior Lu’s eyes instantly widened.

She had been living in Modu for a long time, so she knew how expensive a house in Tomson Building was.

The price of one unit was at least 100 million!

He bought a house worth more than 100 million and a watch worth 31 million.

How could she not scream?

After a long time, Senior Lu finally regained her composure and said, “Yuxuan, does your boyfriend have a younger brother?”

Qin Yuxuan could not help but think of her former roommate who had said something similar. She could not help but smile. “He only has one sister.”

“A sister?” Senior Lu asked. “Actually, I don’t have gender preferences.”

Qin Yuxuan was speechless.

…

Naturally, Lin Fan had no idea about the conversation between Qin Yuxuan and Senior Lu.

After he had a good night’s sleep in the first-class cabin, he arrived in Jiangbei.

Then, Lin Fan drove the Mercedes-Benz back to the Coiling Dragon Villa.

He first brewed a cup of Spirit Tea.

As the Spirit Tea entered his stomach, his mouth was filled with its aroma, and he felt refreshed. In an instant, all the fatigue he had felt over the past few days was swept away.

Lin Fan put down his teacup and took out his phone. His gaze landed on the 3,178 red packets.

The 3,100 red packets were from buying Qin Yuxuan a Patek Philippe watch.

The remaining 78 red packets were from his recent expenses.

“3,178 red packets. Let’s see what I can get,” Lin Fan muttered.

“Open!”

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 9 yuan.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 1,000 yuan.]

…

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received a double shares coupon.]

…

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve obtained 10% of Omar Group’s shares.]

…

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve obtained the skill—Turtle Breathing Technique.]

…

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 19,999 yuan.]

Lin Fan received a total of 1,321,201 yuan from these 3,178 red packets.

Lin Fan chose to ignore this bit of money.

He first set his eyes on the double shares coupon.

Previously, Lin Fan used a double shares coupon on Penguin Group, which gave him a total of 20% of Penguin Group’s shares.

Wanting to give equal treatment, Lin Fan chose Little Tanuki Group this time.

[Ding! The coupon was used successfully. You now own 20% of Little Tanuki Group’s shares.]

Instantly, he gained 10% of Little Tanuki Group’s shares. Lin Fan’s assets increased by another 500 billion yuan.

Omar Group was the world’s largest department store with a market value of 1.4 trillion yuan.

10% of the shares, which was 140 billion yuan, was not bad.

Finally, Lin Fan’s gaze landed on Turtle Breathing Technique.

[Turtle Breathing Technique: A special skill that consumes fat, sugar, and other energy in the body to replace oxygen breathing. You don’t need to breathe to live well, and from there, you can display your infinite charm!]

Seeing this…

Lin Fan’s lips curled up slightly.

Turtle Breathing Technique was definitely a very good skill!
